name: AltTab
title: AltTab: free Contexts alternative
caption:
Contexts charges $9.99 for a better window switcher on Mac. AltTab does the core job for free 🪟

✅ Windows-style alt-tab, with a live preview of every window
✅ Lists each window, not just each app
✅ Finds minimized and hidden windows, even on other Spaces
✅ Free and open source, with no tracking and no telemetry

💻 Mac
ℹ️ AltTab needs Accessibility and Screen Recording permission to read windows and show previews. The core switcher is free forever, but extras like search and more styles are AltTab Pro, free for 14 days, then paid. Contexts is $9.99 as a one-time license

Comment "SWITCH" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

beats.say: If you pay ten bucks for a Mac window switcher, stop scrolling.
This is Windows-style alt-tab for your Mac, with a preview of every window.
Contexts charges nine ninety nine. AltTab costs nothing.
Press the shortcut, and every open window shows up as a live thumbnail.
It finds minimized windows, hidden ones, even windows on other Spaces.
Sixteen thousand people starred it on GitHub, and it's free.
